shop.title: Shop

shop.coin_energy_tomorrow: That's all for today, come back tomorrow
shop.vip_1: Open the firefly jar any time for free
shop.vip_2: Double gems in the daily gift
shop.vip_3: Support the developer and get a crown
shop.vip_terms: Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your Apple ID settings.
jar.title: Firefly jar
jar.about: When your energy is full it doesn't go to waste: fireflies slowly collect it in the jar. Open it for free every 8 hours.
jar.empty: The jar is empty for now. Fireflies start collecting when your energy is full.
daily.title: Daily gift
event.how: Every star from orders on the weekend gives a ribbon 🎀
event.fair.title: Fair by the Well
event.fair.intro: Traders are coming to the square. Mila wants to hang garlands, and Tim dreams of a scarecrow to chase crows off the garden.
event.fair.after.mila: Mila hung the flags and the whole village danced until night. The garland is yours.
event.fair.after.tim: Tim set up the scarecrow and the crows flew off in a huff. The scarecrow is yours.
event.harvest.title: Harvest Festival
event.harvest.intro: A great harvest! Mila wants a cozy nest for bees and birds, and Tim asks for a water trough for the hens.
event.harvest.after.mila: A pair of starlings moved into the nest and sing to Mila every morning. The nest is yours.
event.harvest.after.tim: Tim's hens are now the happiest around. The trough is yours.
event.lights.title: Night of Lights
event.lights.intro: Fireflies gather at the village at night. Mila wants torches by the road, and Tim wants a bench to watch the lights.
event.lights.after.mila: The torches burn till dawn with fireflies circling. The torch is yours.
event.lights.after.tim: Tim and Mila sat on the bench until sunrise. The bench is yours.
decor.hint: Tap to place. Drag to move, long press to put away.
tutorial.spawn: Hi! I'm Mila. The village is in ruins, but we'll rebuild it. Tap the glowing generator to get an item.
tutorial.merge: Great! Now drag an item onto a matching one to merge them into something better.
tutorial.deliver: Villagers post orders at the top. When an item is ready, tap Give to earn stars.
tutorial.build: You have stars! Let's go to the village and build something.

shop.piggy_full: The piggy bank is full! Break it so no gems go to waste
shop.piggy_ready: The piggy bank is ready to break! Check the shop
shop.pass_hint: A second reward on every step of this weekend's track
shop.builder_hint: Stars for buildings and a street lamp. One-time offer
boost.on: Boost on: 2 energy for an item one step higher
postcard.title: Postcards
postcard.how: Every order brings a piece. Complete the postcard to get gems, coins and a decoration.
